title: Diffraction disc
description: A silver disc sends narrow spectral reflections across its fine concentric tracks.
useCase: Use tangent-directed diffraction as a controllable optical material.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. Six approximate spectral orders and authored RGB wavelength response, not a measured optical coating.
look: Flat coral-red field with a centred silver compact disc whose fine concentric grooves carry radiating rainbow bands of cyan, green, magenta and pale blue.
motion: The light angle rocks ±18° on a 29 s sine, swinging the rainbow bands and specular streak across the disc; the track-spacing slider packs more or fewer bands around it.
adapt: All of it is the `FRAGMENT` shader: `theta` swings the light (`u_time*.22`), `u_control` scales dispersion, `wavelength` maps each of six orders to RGB, and `sin(r*1800.)` draws the grooves. Change `bg` with the container background; keep the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
